# TopologicalDataDrivenDesign

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A design methodology where network architecture (e.g., interconnect topology) is derived from topological invariants extracted from biological or simulated activity data. Bridges biological inspiration and TCC hardware by translating observed topological structures into concrete interconnect patterns for high-performance, fault-tolerant computing.
